# Backend Vertical Slice Troubleshooting

Load this file only after a concrete failure. Start from the first relevant
signature, inspect the listed live owner, and re-run the narrow failing check.

| Failure signature | Likely cause | Inspect | Repair and focused proof |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Unable to resolve service for type ... while attempting to activate ...` or `No service for type ... has been registered` | A new implementation is absent, registered against the wrong contract, or injected below/above the approved boundary | `sites/api.arolariu.ro/src/Invoices/Modules/WebApplicationBuilderExtensions.cs`; target constructor; adapter parameter types | Register the interface/implementation once in the owning module using the live sibling lifetime. Ensure adapters inject Management, then exercise service resolution or the narrow host test. |
| `CS1591` or malformed XML documentation diagnostics | A public type/member or changed contract is undocumented, or a `cref`/parameter name is stale | The changed public API, its interface, and a documented sibling; RFC 2004 | Add accurate summary, parameters, returns, exceptions, and remarks where behavior needs them. Do not suppress the warning. Re-run the smallest project build. |
| Build fails because a warning is treated as an error | Nullability, analyzer, async, documentation, or style contract was violated | The first diagnostic and the nearest C# sibling | Fix the source contract rather than adding `NoWarn`, `#pragma`, null-forgiving casts, or weaker analysis. Re-run only the affected project before broadening. |
| `Assert.ThrowsExactly*` expected one type but another type was thrown | The wrong layer owns validation, `Classify` lacks a direct-dependency case, a marker was lost in nested wrappers, or cancellation was wrapped | The changed `*.Exceptions.cs`, concrete inner/outer exception types, and `InvoiceManagementService.Exceptions.cs` | Trace the actual inner chain one layer at a time. Correct only the owning classifier, retain the original inner exception, and assert both exact outer and exact inner types where relevant. |
| Test expected cancellation but receives a domain exception or server fault | `OperationCanceledException` was caught by the generic classifier, the wrong token was forwarded, or endpoint timeout/client-abort classification changed | Every TryCatch partial on the path, `RequestCancellation.cs`, endpoint catch order, cancellation tests | Rethrow cancellation before classification, forward the same token, and prove service propagation plus the adapter's protocol outcome. |
| Activity listener sees no span, the span has no parent, or queued work starts a new trace | Activity starts outside the observed scope, the wrong ActivitySource is used/unregistered, trace context was not propagated, or a consumer parent was not parsed | `ActivityGenerators.cs`, `ActivityExtensions.cs`, the changed method, and `InvoiceProcessingService.ProcessAnalysisAsync` | Match the bounded-context source and `nameof` pattern, keep the Activity alive across awaited work, and preserve validated trace context. Prove name, source, parent, and only required safe tags with an Activity listener. |
| Trace contains payload, free text, URL, credential, or unbounded tag values | A request/provider object or exception detail was added directly to telemetry | The new tag/log parameters and `AnalysisTelemetryTests.cs` | Replace content with an approved identifier, bounded enum, count, duration, or outcome; remove sensitive values and add a privacy regression assertion. |
| JSON deserialization fails, a DTO binds with defaults, or an endpoint response shape differs | Request/response mapping, nullability, property names, enum conversion, or provider-neutral queue contracts diverged | `sites/api.arolariu.ro/src/Invoices/Endpoints/InvoiceEndpoints.Mappings.cs`, affected DTO, `QueueAnalysisMessage.cs`, and DTO/queue contract tests | Fix the transport mapper or contract owner; do not make service layers depend on provider JSON. Add round-trip or handler-level assertions for the exact shape. |
| Architecture/reflection test reports unexpected constructor dependencies or a dependency cycle appears | A layer bypass, sideways call, duplicate responsibility, or excess direct domain collaborator was introduced | `InvoiceStandardLayeringArchitectureTests.cs`, constructor graph, and `layer-decision-table.md` | Move the decision to its highest owning layer, depend only on the next approved role, or extend an existing service. Ask before changing direction or the dependency budget. |
| A targeted test passes alone but fails in the project, or the project build fails after the test passes | Shared static telemetry, fixture isolation, generated contract, compilation of untested files, or another test observes the changed public shape | First project-level failure, test cleanup attributes, builders, and all direct consumers of the changed contract | Remove order/state dependence, reset owned static state, update direct consumers, and advance from one failing test to the smallest owning project only after the first failure is understood. |
| A test cannot reach the endpoint without provisioning external services | The test bootstraps the production host for a handler/mapper contract | `InvoiceEndpointsStatusCodeTests.cs` and the handler's internal signature | Invoke the real handler with a Management test double when the contract under test is endpoint-to-mapper behavior. Use a host/integration boundary only when middleware or registration is itself the behavior. |

Source names in this table are investigation anchors, not permission to change
application behavior to satisfy a stale test. When live behavior and an accepted
RFC disagree materially, surface the drift before editing.
